about: Items 2.0 stage B's typing sheet (rules 1.92). Written by tools/items2_sheet.py from the lead's numbers file, the copy-from rows and the tables' placements; do not edit by hand: change the sources and run the script. B1 types `weapons` and `edits` into data/weapons.json (in this order, after the last row), B2 types `items` into data/items.json; each row as it is here less the keys that begin with an underscore. `holds` are rows that are NOT typed. `families` and `family_teaches` are already in data/families.json (B0).

weapons.text: Held in either hand, one to a hand. +{=effects.0.value} Defense. As a shield it gives you Shield Bash, Raise Shield and Shield Wall, and more Guard from Brace and the Guard technique (a shield in each hand doubles every Guard gain instead). Its own blow rolls with Durability and its damage grows with Endurance. In the off hand it follows: each melee technique of your one-handed main weapon is followed by one blow from it; that blow gives no Guard.
